anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large-radius convex arc characterizing a prominent, bulbous cranial region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Minimal horizontal pixel extension with a high thickness-to-length ratio, resulting in a blunt rostrum profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Pronounced interior angle of approximately 110 degrees at the intersection of the melon's descent and the rostrum's dorsal plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible indentation of the blowhole on the dorsal cranial surface and a broad, spatulate pectoral fin extending ventrally from the mid-torso.
